lines: “帅哥，有没有兴趣陪我喝一杯？”
昏黄的吧台前，一名妩媚妖娆的美女款步走来，冲着埋头喝闷酒的青年抛了个媚眼，犹如玫瑰带露般湿润的红唇微微撅起，让人有种一亲芳泽的冲动。
青年斜着眼，瞧了瞧身前的美女，一条蕾丝露背裙，体态丰腴，饱满的双峰仿佛要挣脱衣带的束缚，呼之欲出。一头波浪卷发下，是一张鹅蛋型脸庞，随着她的身体靠近，一股浓郁的香味立刻扑鼻而来。
他放下酒杯，玩味的打量着对方，缓缓道：“你想泡我？”
美女一怔，没想到青年会毫不留情的揭穿自己的想法。不过，她好歹是久经风月的女人，岂会被轻易吓走，她捂着嘴，笑得花枝乱颤，咯咯道：“那你愿不愿意让我泡？”
女人说完这句话，也没征求同意，就主动在青年旁边坐了下去。
因为她这种大胆直接的方式，酒吧中的其他女人顿时投来羡慕嫉妒的眼神。
来酒吧厮混的人，无论男女，其实都是前来寻求刺激的，她们早就注意到了青年的存在。
对方从进来到现在，一直安静的坐在那，一杯接一杯，仿佛心事重重。
那青年二十多岁的年纪，面部轮廓透着一丝刚硬的线条，端端正正，英气十足，非常耐看，两道浓眉犹如被磨平的棱角，少了几分张扬，多了几分稳重。墨澈般的黑眸下，忧郁，愤怒，不甘，种种情绪交织成河，缓缓流入深邃的瞳仁。
虽然穿着很随意，但那种神秘而出众的气质，却是深深吸引着在场女性。
“帅哥，我叫璐璐，你叫什么？”美女翘着腿，穿着诱人黑丝的长腿上下摆动，高跟鞋有意无意的触碰着青年的腿部，眼神满是挑逗的意味。
“江来。”青年的嘴中蹦出两个字。
“将来？这名字挺有特色。”美女打趣说。
江来根本没理会，自顾自的喝着威士忌。见他迟迟不接腔，璐璐顿时有种被无视的感觉。可是，既然是她主动的，也怪不得被人对她不理不睬。再说，好不容易猎到这种长相和身材都属上上选的极品男人，她舍不得放弃。
“听你的口音好像不是本地人，你是第一次来QZ市吗？”
“你来干什么？”璐璐饶有兴趣的问道：“旅游？要不要姐姐免费当导游陪你玩几天？”
“找人。”
“什么人？”
“一个女人。”
璐璐恍然道：“该不会是跟你女朋友吵架，把她给气走了吧。弟弟，听姐姐一句劝，女人是最心软的动物，只要你说两句好听的，她立马回心转意。”
“你说得对，我的确跟她吵架了。”江来淡淡的说道：“但我并不打算带她回去。”
“我要杀了她！”
听到这话，璐璐再次愣住了，当江来说出‘杀’的一瞬间，她突然感觉浑身冰冷，寒意遍体，不自觉的打了个冷颤。如果不是强烈的好奇心驱使，她早已经坐不住了。
“你为什么要这么做？”她小心翼翼的问道。很难想象，到底是什么样的仇怨，让这个男人竟然恨不得杀死自己的女朋友，就算被戴了绿帽子，也不至于这样吧。
“你想知道？”
江来拉下自己的背心肩带，在他的心脏部位，露出一道狰狞的伤疤。这道伤疤似乎刚好没多久，连血痂都没完全脱落。
“医生告诉我说，如果她的匕首再偏离一毫米，我这条命就没了。不仅如此，我最好的几位兄弟都因为她而间接被害。”说到这，江来自嘲的笑道：“有句老话说得好，最毒妇人心！她是这个世界上最漂亮的女人，同样也是这个世界上心肠最歹毒的女人。所以，漂亮的女人是一味毒药，让人痛不欲生。”
璐璐挤出一丝笑容，想要化解二人间尴尬的氛围，打趣道：“那你愿不愿意品尝下姐姐这杯毒药？”说着，她把两片红唇凑到江来的耳边，媚眼如丝道：“姐姐这杯毒药更毒，保准让你欲仙欲死。”
“你？”江来慢慢转过头，端详着那张被粉底覆盖的脸庞，嘴角突地扬起，“如果你是毒药，你觉得你能坐在这听我讲故事吗？我说过，我现在讨厌漂亮的女人，不过，我更痛恨不洁身自好的女人。滚吧，少在这里烦我。”
璐璐脸色微变，倏地站起身，冷冷看着他道：“说这么多废话，原来是为了挖苦我。哼！你们男人没一个好东西。”
看着美女怒气冲冲离去的倩影，江来嗤笑了一声，把玩着手中的玻璃酒杯，眼神渐渐变得坚定而冰冷，“卿曼容，最好别让我抓到你，否则的话，我一定杀了你！”
“拿酒，快拿酒来！”
喃喃自语中，一个不耐烦的声音陡地传来。江来目光一扫，注意力立刻被吧台角落的女人吸引住了。刚进酒吧的时候，他习惯性的将周围的环境和顾客全部收入眼底，也包括那个女人。对方跟他差不多，一直躲在昏黄的灯光下喝闷酒。在她面前，已经摆了七八个空酒杯。
这个世界上的伤心人太多，而酒是唯一的消愁药！
“这位小姐，你已经醉了，还是回家吧。”酒保好心的劝道：“要不我替你叫辆计程车。”
“不要！”女人挥舞着手臂，醉醺醺的大叫道：“我不用你管我，酒！我要喝酒！你……你是不是怕我没钱？我告诉你，我……我有的是钱，不信你看，我有……好多好多钱……”说着，她从随身携带的精美挎包中掏出一叠厚厚的钞票，用力甩向半空。顿时，上百张百元大钞飘飘洒洒，到处都是，引起了酒吧客人们的注意。
“你看……我……我有钱，快给我拿酒。”女人不顾自己引起的轰动，吵着要酒喝。
酒保有些犹豫，还想继续劝劝对方，但这时，只听‘砰’的一声，一只大手狠狠拍在吧台上，一名身材魁梧，满脸横肉的彪形大汉开口道：“没听到这位小姐的要求吗？顾客是上帝，既然上帝要酒喝，那你还不赶快给她拿来，是不是找抽？”
看到眼前的大汉，酒保好像认出来人，面色微微一变，到嘴的话立刻咽了回去，不情不愿的将一杯鸡尾酒送到女人手中。
“嘿嘿！美女，一个人喝酒多无趣，要不咱们哥几个陪你玩玩？”
content_en:
"Handsome guy, are you interested in having a drink with me?"
In front of the dim bar, a charming and enchanting beauty walked up and winked at the young man who was immersed in drinking. Her red lips, as moist as roses with dew, were slightly pursed, making people feel the urge to kiss her.
The young man squinted his eyes and glanced at the beautiful woman in front of him. She was wearing a lace backless skirt, with a plump body, and her plump breasts seemed to be breaking free from the constraints of the belt, ready to come out. Under her wavy hair was an oval-shaped face. As her body came closer, a rich fragrance immediately hit her nostrils.
He put down his wine glass, looked at the other person playfully, and said slowly: "You want to pick me up?"
The beauty was startled, not expecting that the young man would reveal her thoughts mercilessly. However, after all, she is a woman who has experienced many romances, how can she be scared away easily? She covered her mouth, laughed so hard, and giggled: "Then are you willing to let me soak?"
After the woman said this, she took the initiative to sit down next to the young man without asking for permission.
Because of her bold and direct approach, other women in the bar immediately cast envious and jealous looks.
People who come to the bar to hang out, regardless of whether they are men or women, are actually here to seek excitement. They have long noticed the existence of young people.
The other party has been sitting there quietly from the moment he came in, drinking one cup after another, as if he was deeply preoccupied.
The young man was in his twenties, and his facial contour showed a trace of rigid lines. He was upright, full of heroic spirit, and very attractive. His two thick eyebrows were like smoothed edges, a little less arrogant and a little more stable. Under the clear black eyes, melancholy, anger, unwillingness, and various emotions intertwined into a river, slowly flowing into the deep pupils.
Although he was dressed casually, his mysterious and outstanding temperament deeply attracted the women present.
"Handsome guy, my name is Lulu, what's your name?" The beauty crossed her legs, her long legs in seductive black stockings swinging up and down, her high heels touching the young man's legs intentionally or unintentionally, her eyes full of provocation.
"Jiang Lai." Two words popped out of the young man's mouth.
"Future? This name is quite unique." The beauty joked.
Jiang Lai didn't pay attention at all and drank his whiskey. Seeing that he didn't answer, Lulu suddenly felt like she was being ignored. However, since she took the initiative, no wonder she was ignored. Besides, she finally found such a top-notch man with the best looks and figure, and she couldn't bear to give up.
"Your accent sounds like you are not a local. Is this your first time in QZ City?"
"Yes!"
"What are you here for?" Lulu asked with interest: "Traveling? Do you want my sister to be a tour guide for free and accompany you for a few days?"
"Find someone."
"Who?"
"A woman."
Lulu suddenly said: "Is it possible that you had a fight with your girlfriend and made her angry? Brother, listen to my sister's advice. Women are the most soft-hearted animals. As long as you say a few nice words, she will change her mind immediately."
"You're right, I did quarrel with her." Jiang Lai said calmly: "But I don't plan to take her back."
"Then you..."
"I'm going to kill her!"
Hearing this, Lulu was stunned again. The moment Jiang Lai said 'kill', she suddenly felt cold and chilled all over her body, and shivered unconsciously. If it weren't for her strong curiosity, she would have been unable to sit still.
"Why are you doing this?" she asked cautiously. It's hard to imagine what kind of hatred made this man want to kill his girlfriend. Even if he was cuckolded, it wouldn't be like this.
"You want to know?"
Jiang Lai pulled down the shoulder straps of his vest, revealing a hideous scar on his heart. This scar seems to have just happened not long ago, and even the bloody scab has not completely fallen off.
"The doctor told me that if her dagger was even one millimeter off, my life would be over. Not only that, several of my best brothers were indirectly killed because of her." Speaking of this, Jiang said with a self-deprecating smile: "There is an old saying that women's hearts are the most poisonous! She is the most beautiful woman in the world, and she is also the most vicious-hearted woman in the world. Therefore, a beautiful woman is poison, which makes people miserable."
Lulu forced out a smile, trying to resolve the awkward atmosphere between the two of them, and joked: "Then would you like to taste sister's cup of poison?" As she said that, she put her two red lips to Jiang Lai's ear, and said with a charming look: "Sister, this cup of poison is even more poisonous, and it will definitely make you want to die."
"You?" Jiang Lai slowly turned his head, looked at the face covered with foundation, and raised the corners of his mouth suddenly, "If you were poison, do you think you could sit here and listen to my story? I said that I hate beautiful women now, but I hate dirty women even more. Go away and stop bothering me here."
Lulu's face changed slightly, she stood up quickly, looked at him coldly and said, "You talk so much nonsense just to ridicule me. Humph! None of you men are good."
Seeing the beautiful woman leaving angrily, Jiang Lai sneered and played with the glass in his hand. His eyes gradually became firm and cold, "Qing Manrong, you'd better not let me catch you, otherwise, I will definitely kill you!"
"Bring the wine, quickly bring the wine!"
While muttering to himself, an impatient voice suddenly came. Jiang Lai glanced around and his attention was immediately attracted by the woman in the corner of the bar. When he first entered the bar, he habitually took in all the surrounding environment and customers, including the woman. The other person was similar to him, always hiding in the dim light and drinking. In front of her, there were seven or eight empty wine glasses.
There are too many sad people in this world, and wine is the only medicine to relieve sorrow!
"Miss, you're already drunk. You'd better go home." The bartender kindly advised, "How about I call a taxi for you."
"No!" The woman waved her arms and shouted drunkenly: "I don't need you to worry about me, wine! I want to drink! You...are you afraid that I have no money? Let me tell you, I...I have a lot of money. If you don't believe it, look, I have...a lot of money..." As she said that, she took out a thick stack of banknotes from the exquisite satchel she carried with her and threw it into the air. Suddenly, hundreds of hundred-dollar bills were flying everywhere, attracting the attention of the bar patrons.
"Look...I...I have money, get me a drink quickly." The woman ignored the commotion she caused and clamored for a drink.
The bartender was a little hesitant and wanted to continue to persuade the other party, but at this time, there was only a "bang" sound, and a big hand was slapped hard on the bar. A burly man with a sinewy face said: "Didn't you hear this lady's request? The customer is God. Since God wants wine, then if you don't get it to her quickly, are you looking for trouble?"
Seeing the big man in front of him, the bartender seemed to recognize him, his expression changed slightly, he immediately swallowed the words that came to his mouth, and reluctantly handed a cocktail to the woman's hand.
"Hey! Beauty, drinking alone is boring. How about some of our brothers play with you?"
